description:
We're a 2-person AI/DS team from India taking on "Flame in Freefall" - an AI
dashboard that ranks NASA's microgravity combustion experiments and predicts fire
risk from oxygen, pressure and airflow. Stack: Python, LightGBM, SHAP, Streamlit.
Looking for a frontend/UI dev and someone who enjoys video editing. Fully virtual,
working in English, 14-15 Nov. If you like data + design, join us!
